label: Speedometer
author: Conky-Studio
description: Universal dial gauge for any numeric source (fans, speed, load, custom). Set Min/Max to match your scale; major tick labels show those values (e.g. 10, 20, 30). No unit text baked in - pair with a Text Label for RPM, km/h, etc.

properties.label: Warn zone from
properties.help: Where the warning band begins on the same scale as Min/Max. Set >= Max to hide.

properties.label: Major ticks
properties.help: Number of labeled major divisions between Min and Max inclusive.

lua_draw_body:
local cx, cy, R = {cx}, {cy}, {radius}
 local min_v, max_v = {min_value}, {max_value}
 local span = max_v - min_v
 if span == 0 then span = 1 end
 local val = tonumber({value}) or min_v
 local pct = (val - min_v) / span
 if pct < 0 then pct = 0 elseif pct > 1 then pct = 1 end
 local a0 = {start_angle}
 local a1 = {end_angle}
 local sweep = (a1 - a0) % 360
 if sweep <= 0 then sweep = 360 end
 local tr, tg, tb = {track_color}
 local tkr, tkg, tkb = {tick_color}
 local rr, rg, rb = {redline_color}
 local nr, ng, nb = {needle_color}
 local hr, hg, hb = {hub_color}
 cairo_set_line_width(cr, 10)
 cairo_set_line_cap(cr, CAIRO_LINE_CAP_BUTT)
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, tr, tg, tb, {opacity})
 cairo_new_sub_path(cr)
 cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, R, math.rad(a0), math.rad(a0 + sweep))
 cairo_stroke(cr)
 local rl = {redline_start}
 local rl_pct = (rl - min_v) / span
 if rl_pct < 0 then rl_pct = 0 elseif rl_pct > 1 then rl_pct = 1 end
 if rl_pct < 0.999 then
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, rr, rg, rb, {opacity} * 0.85)
  cairo_set_line_width(cr, 10)
  cairo_new_sub_path(cr)
  cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, R, math.rad(a0 + sweep * rl_pct), math.rad(a0 + sweep))
  cairo_stroke(cr)
 end
 local majors = math.floor({major_ticks} + 0.5)
 if majors < 1 then majors = 1 end
 local minors = math.floor({minor_per_major} + 0.5)
 cairo_set_line_cap(cr, CAIRO_LINE_CAP_BUTT)
 for i = 0, majors do
  local t = i / majors
  local ang = math.rad(a0 + sweep * t)
  cairo_set_line_width(cr, 2.5)
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, tkr, tkg, tkb, {opacity})
  local x1 = cx + math.cos(ang) * (R - 4)
  local y1 = cy + math.sin(ang) * (R - 4)
  local x2 = cx + math.cos(ang) * (R - 18)
  local y2 = cy + math.sin(ang) * (R - 18)
  cairo_move_to(cr, x1, y1)
  cairo_line_to(cr, x2, y2)
  cairo_stroke(cr)
  if {show_labels} then
   local label_v = min_v + span * t
   local label = string.format('%.0f', label_v)
   local lx = cx + math.cos(ang) * (R - 30)
   local ly = cy + math.sin(ang) * (R - 30)
   cairo_select_font_face(cr, 'Sans', CAIRO_FONT_SLANT_NORMAL, CAIRO_FONT_WEIGHT_NORMAL)
   cairo_set_font_size(cr, {label_size})
   local ext = cairo_text_extents_t:create()
   tolua.takeownership(ext)
   cairo_text_extents(cr, label, ext)
   cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, tkr, tkg, tkb, {opacity})
   cairo_move_to(cr, lx - ext.width / 2 - ext.x_bearing, ly - ext.y_bearing / 2)
   cairo_show_text(cr, label)
  end
  if i < majors and minors > 0 then
   cairo_set_line_width(cr, 1.2)
   cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, tkr, tkg, tkb, {opacity} * 0.55)
   for j = 1, minors do
    local tm = (i + j / (minors + 1)) / majors
    local am = math.rad(a0 + sweep * tm)
    local mx1 = cx + math.cos(am) * (R - 4)
    local my1 = cy + math.sin(am) * (R - 4)
    local mx2 = cx + math.cos(am) * (R - 11)
    local my2 = cy + math.sin(am) * (R - 11)
    cairo_move_to(cr, mx1, my1)
    cairo_line_to(cr, mx2, my2)
    cairo_stroke(cr)
   end
  end
 end
 local na = math.rad(a0 + sweep * pct)
 local nlen = R - 22
 cairo_set_line_width(cr, 3)
 cairo_set_line_cap(cr, CAIRO_LINE_CAP_ROUND)
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, nr, ng, nb, {opacity})
 cairo_move_to(cr, cx - math.cos(na) * 12, cy - math.sin(na) * 12)
 cairo_line_to(cr, cx + math.cos(na) * nlen, cy + math.sin(na) * nlen)
 cairo_stroke(cr)
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, hr, hg, hb, {opacity})
 cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, 8, 0, 2 * math.pi)
 cairo_fill(cr)
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, nr, ng, nb, {opacity} * 0.9)
 cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, 3.5, 0, 2 * math.pi)
 cairo_fill(cr)
 if {show_value} then
  local label = string.format('%.0f', val)
  cairo_select_font_face(cr, 'Sans', CAIRO_FONT_SLANT_NORMAL, CAIRO_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD)
  cairo_set_font_size(cr, {value_size})
  local ext = cairo_text_extents_t:create()
  tolua.takeownership(ext)
  cairo_text_extents(cr, label, ext)
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, tkr, tkg, tkb, {opacity})
  cairo_move_to(cr, cx - ext.width / 2 - ext.x_bearing, cy + R * 0.42 - ext.y_bearing)
  cairo_show_text(cr, label)
 end
